records.title: FAO agricultural statistics support for Zimbabwe
records.description: FAO's Global Strategy for Agricultural and Rural Statistics provides a regional reference framework for strengthening national agricultural statistical systems and data capacity.

records.title: FAO Southern Africa resilience and early-warning support
records.description: FAO reports strengthened anticipatory action, early warning and climate-resilience support across Southern Africa, including Zimbabwe, with drought recovery and climate-smart agriculture measures.

records.title: GAFSP Ninth Call — Zimbabwe country-led project participation
records.description: The Global Agriculture and Food Security Program recorded Zimbabwe among African countries submitting a proposal to its ninth country-led project call in 2026; this is a programme reference rather than an open farmer application.
